admission.justification: The actual converted paired-closeout regression binds the judged tree, published content tree, record bytes and both subsequent public read forms; it catches backfill that would change the reviewed record or lose its publication attribution.

applicability: Successful converted paired leaf closeout of a judged memory candidate containing a closure without a stored commit, followed by public weakness and record reads.
conditions: The ordinary closeout admission and transaction requirements are satisfied; the published memory content tree is the exact tree judged by the gate.
The closed record bytes remain unchanged across that publication.
Read attribution succeeds only when the selected closure has a unique introducing memory commit with a readable final Code-Commit trailer naming a full real code commit.
exclusions: No closeout success is promised when a normal gate or transaction refuses.
This does not authorize a real closeout or settlement of any particular held weakness.
Pending or unavailable attribution is reported instead of inventing a commit when the reader’s origin or pair requirements are unmet.

evidence: 261112-BUG-L3-W9-worker.md, item17 acceptance block, checks and Closure census; W9-evidence.tar.gz contains the exact red/green test results and executable commands.

statement: Closeout publishes the judged memory tree without backfilling a deferred closure, and the subsequent reader derives its code commit from that publication.
